name: ashlar-clean
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE INDIVIDUAL modular stone piece for constructing a premium stylized tropical ruined temple in a game. Muted warm limestone with sage-grey shadows and pale warm rubbed edges, extremely restrained material detail, broad sculpted bevels. No shiny gold, no microscopic noise. Neutral soft studio illumination. Whole isolated object on pale grey, no base plane, no scenery, no building, no text, no diagram labels, no watermark. Three-quarter orthographic view with generous margin. A completely PLAIN structural masonry block, 2m wide x 1m high x 1m deep. Six broad flat unbroken faces, thick shallow rounded chamfer on all twelve edges, four corners each subtly worn in a different way. The center of every face is intact, smooth and calm: ABSOLUTELY NO holes, craters, cracks, carved lines, symbols or depressions. Gentle broad tonal patches of warm grey stone are the only face detail. A little dark patina only right against two bottom edges. The beautiful edge profile and clear volume should do all the work. Solid professional environment-kit building block.
